overall: Atlanta hit its daily peak of 91.4°F around 15:00 ET and has held that running max unchanged through 23:19 ET, confirming the afternoon high is locked in. Temperatures have since dropped to 82.4°F and are cooling at -1.8°F/hr, well into the overnight regime. The day ran slightly warmer than the cooler ECMWF guidance but landed squarely in line with the GFS and HRRR solutions.
forecast_obs_notes: GFS and HRRR were nearly perfect at 91.3°F versus the observed 91.4°F, while ECMWF underperformed at 90.1°F and NBM overshot at 92.2°F. The strong model agreement between GFS and HRRR bracketing the actual observed max gives high confidence the peak observation is genuine and not a sensor artifact.
max_temp_prediction: With the running max stalled at 91.4°F for over 8 hours and active overnight cooling underway from 82.4°F at -1.8°F/hr, there is no physical pathway for temperatures to recover and challenge the afternoon peak tonight. The daily TMAX of 91.4°F is essentially confirmed with near-certainty — the only remaining uncertainty is instrument rounding at the observing station.
